GenAiFunction.description: Analyzes an Account Manager portfolio using approved Account, Opportunity, Case, Activity, Services, Finance, and usage signals for all matched Accounts. Use this before answering portfolio-wide or plural analysis requests such as which accounts in my portfolio need immediate attention, best expansion opportunities, churn watchlists, or weekly multi-account planning. Do not require a specific Account name or Salesforce Account ID before invoking this action. When the action returns portfolioBrief, copy that brief as the user-facing answer. The analysis ranks portfolio risk, expansion opportunity, trends, watchlists, proactive recommendations, and weekly execution plans.
